item.text: The rollback failure is caused by migration 2 making `amount_cents` `NOT NULL`: the old release’s insert statement omits that new column, so it cannot accept traffic after rollback. I’ll preserve backward-write compatibility by allowing legacy inserts to leave the new column null, while all ledger reads fall back to the legacy amount in cents; new writes still populate `amount_cents`.
